description: This file defines an enumeration 'ThingLifecycle' representing the lifecycle states of a 'Thing' in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes states such as ACTIVE and DELETED, along with a static method to retrieve a lifecycle state based on its name.

classes.name: ThingLifecycle
classes.description: An enumeration representing the lifecycle states of a 'Thing', such as ACTIVE and DELETED, with a utility method to retrieve an enum constant by name.

methods.name: forName
methods.description: A static method that returns an Optional containing the 'ThingLifecycle' enum constant matching the given name, or an empty Optional if no match is found.
